$comment: The PostHog project settings every dashboard depends on. `mise analytics:check` fails when the live project differs from `settings`; change the project here first, then in PostHog. Each test-account rule is a null-safe exclusion: PostHog ANDs them into every filtered query, so a rule that is NULL or true for a real event drops it.

test_account_filters.key: properties.$host IS NULL OR NOT match(properties.$host, '^(localhost|127\\.0\\.0\\.1)($|:)')

NOT ifNull(properties.$device_type = 'Desktop' AND properties.$os = 'Linux' AND properties.$browser = 'Chrome' AND properties.$referring_domain ILIKE '%google.com%' AND properties.$geoip_country_code = 'US' AND (properties.$geoip_city_name IS NULL OR properties.$geoip_city_name = ''), false)

NOT ifNull(lower(properties.$raw_user_agent) ILIKE '%googlebot%' OR lower(properties.$raw_user_agent) ILIKE '%bingbot%' OR lower(properties.$raw_user_agent) ILIKE '%duckduckbot%' OR lower(properties.$raw_user_agent) ILIKE '%slurp%' OR lower(properties.$raw_user_agent) ILIKE '%crawler%', false)
